outer_rule: First 63 exchange observations in each 2024/2025 half-year, no 2026 evaluation; all history exploratory
gate_design: Shared frozen estimators; temperature on 63-session calibration; reused calibration gate versus distinct purged 63-session gate, improvement=.01; gates select calibrated forecast vs trailing prior
fractions: Most recent registered fraction of eligible fit rows; no random shuffling
transfer: Each target absent from all fitting, scaling, calibration, gating and class-return estimation. SPY contemporaneous covariate retained; ETF economic overlap acknowledged.
selection: No hyperparameter or winner search; fixed logistic and HGB settings; temperature candidate choice uses calibration only; no outer tuning
stochastic_note: HGB early_stopping=False with no row subsampling; seed replay may be identical and is not independent temporal evidence

inference.holm_family: All 17 registered predictive contrasts, separately all 8 economic contrasts
inference.resampling: Mean across symbols per session then circular contiguous blocks within each 63-session outer block; outer blocks remain separate

exclusions.XGB/LGBM/LSTM/MoE: Existing legacy bundles lack evidence binding their transformations, training endpoints, calibration roles and execution labels to these new outer partitions. They are not admitted via saved scores; reengineering all candidate contracts exceeds fixed 1800-fit comparison budget. Fixed logistic and nonlinear HGB provide eligible component controls. No claim to superiority over excluded architectures.
exclusions.macro_news_crypto: No historical as-of vintage/content availability record; excluded rather than filled with synthetic zeros.
